The '''Dantus sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Leveler]]'' was stationed there while undergoing tests of experimental weapons.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Karen Traviss]]' [[2009]] book ''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'' incorrectly places [[JanFathal]] and the [[Fath system]] in the Dantus sector.
